fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program provides a theoretical knowledge of economics and trade for international students. Develop a systematic command of basic theories and tools of economics and management science; Understand the basic rules and operations of international trade, including the principles of international trade bodies such as the WTO; Understand computer applications for trade analysis and management; Acquire through theory and practice, cross-cultural literacy and, improved proficiency in English, and enhanced Chinese language skills. 2. Courses Introduction Editor Notes: This program provides 11 main courses and offers different kinds of career direction in the future for international students. Main Courses The core courses are: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Principles of Transnational Corporations Management, International Finance, Financial Management, Principles of Accounting, International Marketing,International Trade,Business Neogotiation,Chinese Language,Introduction to Chinese Culture. 3. Career Prospects Editor Notes: Most graduates are high demand by employers. Graduates are in high demand in fields of international business and economics, multinational enterprises, and governmental departments of economics, foreign trade companies, and export-oriented enterprises and securities traders. 4. University Introduction Editor Notes: SCUT is a key comprehensive research-oriented university under Project 985 and Project 211. South China University of Technology (SCUT) is one of China's leading universities. South China University of Technology is a key comprehensive research-oriented university under Project 985 and Project 211. It operates under the direct leadership of the State Ministry of Education. SCUT is a member of Project 985 and Project 211 which means top excellent in teaching and research, it is one of the universities approved by MOE to accept international students on Chinese Government Scholarships, Learn More>> 5. School of Economics and Commerce Editor Notes: It is a key school of economics and commerce in south China. 4.1 Introduction of the Department The School enjoys abundant teaching resources, excellent education conditions and strong academic atmosphere. The School is recognized as one of the rapid developing schools in the university. The School promotes all-round development in teaching and research, serves regional economic and social development, and strengthens international cooperation. 4.2 Faculty Subject: International Trade and Industrial Cluster Professor Kuang Guoliang Master of Industrial Economy of South China University of Technology Subject: Management Economics Professor Long Zhihe Doctor of Management Science and Engineering in Southwest Jiaotong University, China(2000) ​ Subject: E-Business Professor Qi Ming Dean of Intellectual Property Information Engineering Institute 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Sports Meeting Southeast Asian Food Festival

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. English test result(TOEFL/IELTS) * 2. 2 Recommendation Letters * 3. Original copy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (must be filed out in Chinese or English, the result is only valid for 1 year). * 4. Passport Copy (Valid duration covers your study period at SCUT) With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least 12 months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 5. Passport photo Within six months. * 6. High school academic transcript Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. High School O'Level Certificate and Transcripts Those who have not graduated from high school, submit a Pre-graduation Certificate, or a testimonial which shows your expected graduation time and present your original high school certification, transcripts and their translations when you register. * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and be under the age of 25. 2. The information page of valid Ordinary Passport. Visa page or Residence Permit page is required to provide for applicants currently in China. 3. China Scholastic Competency Assessment certificate(CSCA), details download here . 4. High school graduate with good record or equivalent certificate. Applicants who have not yet completed high school should provide a pre-graduation certificate or a testimonial indicating the expected graduationdate (Please ensure that you submit the official graduation certificate and transcripts before enrollment). 5. The language proficiency certificate must be valid at the time of enrollment and is only valid for 2 years. 1)Language Requirements for English Medium Programs (only for non-English speaking countries, language certificate must be valid for the latest 2 years) TOEFL IBT 68 or above IELTS 5.5 or above Duolingo English test 100 scores or above Other equivalent English language qualifications (e.g. TOEFL Essentials ™m Scores and TOEFL MyBest! Scores etc.) 2)Language Requirements for Bilingual Program HSK Level 4 with 180 scores or above for Science or Engineering studies; HSK Level 5 with 180 scores orabove for Economics & Management Studies; HSK Speaking Test (intermediate Level) score is required. TOEFL lBT 68 or above; lELTS 5.5 or above; Duolingo English tests 100 scores or above; Other equivalentEnglish language qualifications. 3)Those students who are exempt from submitting an English Language Certificate must meet all thefollowing conditions A citizen of an English-speaking country Obtained the highest-level degree of education from an institution operating in English and submiting a proof issued by the instruction.
